    _validate_balances(balances)
    _validate_seen(seen)
    if not isinstance(operations, list):
        raise ValueError("operations must be a list")
    current = dict(balances)
    new_seen = set(seen)
    for op in operations:
        if not isinstance(op, dict):
            raise ValueError("operation must be a dict")
        if "id" not in op:
            raise ValueError("operation must contain id")
        op_id = op["id"]
        if not isinstance(op_id, str) or op_id == "":
            raise ValueError("operation id must be a non-empty string")
        if op_id in new_seen:
            continue
        if "source" not in op or "destination" not in op or "amount" not in op:
            raise ValueError("operation requires source, destination and amount")
        source = op["source"]
        destination = op["destination"]
        amount = op["amount"]
        if not isinstance(source, str) or source == "":
            raise ValueError("source must be a non-empty string")
        if not isinstance(destination, str) or destination == "":
            raise ValueError("destination must be a non-empty string")
        if source == destination:
            raise ValueError("source and destination must be distinct")
        if source not in current or destination not in current:
            raise ValueError("source and destination must exist")
        if not _is_int(amount) or amount <= 0:
            raise ValueError("amount must be a positive integer")
        if current[source] < amount:
            raise ValueError("insufficient funds")
        current[source] -= amount
        current[destination] += amount
        new_seen.add(op_id)
    return current, new_seen
